rationale: The Court is likely to hold that § 5110’s effective-date scheme is a substantive, exception-laden limit on retroactive monetary entitlement—signaled by “shall not be earlier than … unless specifically provided otherwise”—so equitable tolling would create an extra-statutory exception. A Sotomayor dissent is likely to invoke Irwin/Henderson and the veteran-friendly context to argue the one-year condition should be tollable in extraordinary incapacity cases.
